title: 36 Hours in Munich
abstract: While the city’s beer gardens are as lively as ever, Munich is pushing to challenge Berlin as Germany’s cultural capital.

title: 36 Hours in Edinburgh
abstract: Walk up the Royal Mile, browse portraits of famous Scots and pop in for a pint during a weekend in Scotland’s capital.

title: 36 Hours in the Hudson Valley, New York
abstract: From art and antiques to history and hiking to restaurants and river views, get ready for a packed weekend in this region north of New York City.
